description: This Java class implements a Liquibase custom precondition to verify that all free text dose units and frequencies in drug orders are mapped to concepts before upgrading to version 1.10 of OpenMRS. It performs database queries to identify unmapped entries and throws exceptions if any unmapped items are found.

classes.name: CheckDrugOrderUnitAndFrequencyTextNotMappedToConcepts
classes.description: Implements Liquibase's CustomPrecondition interface to verify that drug order dose units and frequencies are mapped before upgrade.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Executes the check to find unmapped dose units and frequencies, throwing exceptions if unmapped entries are found.

methods.name: getUnMappedText
methods.description: Filters the provided set of texts to identify those that are not mapped to concepts.
